turns.content: Meri best friend Shreya ki shaadi ke dates aa gaye — aur uska sangeet plus cocktail night bilkul Ramzan ke beech mein pad raha hai. Mera roza hoga. Hum pandrah saal ki umar se uski shaadi plan kar rahe hain, main basically is sangeet ki co-director hoon. Woh keh rahi hai "opening dance toh tujhe mere saath karna HI hai." Main karna bhi chahti hoon. Aur saath mein poori cheez se darr bhi lag raha hai.

Aww, yeh toh bilkul "dil kahe haan, body kahe soche" wali situation hai! 😅

Sach bolun? Yeh dono cheezein ek saath ho sakti hain — bas thoda smart plan karna hoga.

Pehli baat: roza chhodo ya dance chhodo, aisa koi binary choice nahi hai. Fasting ke time dance karna bilkul possible hai, especially evening sangeet — jab iftaar ke baad hi energy wapas aati hai. Opening dance likely raat mein hi hoga, tab tumhe energy bhi milegi.

Kuch practical cheezein jo help kar sakti hain:

- **Rehearsals** thodi light rakhna, ideally sehri ke baad ya iftaar ke baad. Full-on 2 ghante ki intense practice subah noon mein avoid karo.
- **Sehri** ko seriously lena — banana, oats, dates, paani zyada. Woh tumhe din bhar chal payenge.
- Choreography thodi energetic-but-smart rakhna — Shreya ko bata dena ki "opening toh karenge, par thoda elegant wala, 7 minute ka dhamaal nahi."

Aur darr jo lag raha hai — woh natural hai. 15 saal ki planning, best friend ki shaadi, tum co-director ho... pressure toh hoga hi. Par darr isliye bhi hai kyunki tum dono cheezon ko seriously leti ho — apna roza bhi, apni dost bhi. Woh achi baat hai, weakness nahi.

Ek baat batao — rehearsals kab se shuru kar rahi ho? Aur koi aisi cheez hai jisko lekar sabse zyada tension hai — physical energy, ya log kya sochenge?

Kal usne bade pyaar se bola, "ek din roze ka kya farak padta hai na, main khud tujhe khila dungi." Woh mean nahi ho rahi thi — usko bas pata nahi woh kya maang rahi hai. Aur doosri taraf Ammi ne bola "poore Ramzan mein sangeet-vangeet theek nahi lagta." Toh ab main us rassi jaisi hoon jisko dono taraf se kheench rahe hain, dono mujhse pyaar karte hain, dono ko samajh nahi aa raha.

Yeh wali feeling na — "rassi jaisi" — yeh sabse exhausting hoti hai. Kyunki agar koi ek taraf villain hota toh larna aasan hota. Yahan dono taraf pyaar hai, bas dono alag duniyaon se bol rahe hain.

Shreya ko samajh nahi aa raha kyunki uske liye roza ek "ek din skip" cheez hai — usko yeh nahi pata ki roza sirf khana-peeda nahi hai, woh 30 din ka ek poora commitment hai, ek connection. Aur "main khud khila dungi" — uske dimag mein yeh pyaar ka offer tha, samajh nahi aayi ki woh tumse kya maang rahi hai. Usne shayad kabhi kisi se roza karte dekha nahi closely.

Aur Ammi ko samajh nahi aa raha kyunki unki generation ke liye sangeet aur Ramzan alag boxes hain. Unko shayad yeh nahi pata ki tum dono ko 10 saal se is din ka intezaar tha, aur date tumne choose nahi ki.

Ek baat jo shayad dono ko samajhni hai: **tum kisi ek ko choose nahi kar rahi ho.** Tum apne roze bhi rakh rahi ho, apni dost ke saath bhi khadi ho. Dono ek saath. Yeh message hi dono ko dena hai, bas alag-alag language mein:

- **Shreya ko:** "Yaar, mera roza mere liye non-negotiable hai, bilkul waise jaise tera sangeet tere liye. Par main dance karungi — iftaar ke baad, full energy ke saath. Bas mujhe roza todwane ki offer mat karna, woh mujhe hurt karta hai."
- **Ammi ko:** "Main poora Ramzan rakh rahi hoon, koi roza nahi chhootega. Shreya meri behen jaisi hai aur main uske saath khadi rahungi — par deen ke daayre mein rehkar."

Ek baar dono ko clear ho jayega ki tum mein se koi "haar" nahi raha, dono ko asaan ho jayega.

Ab sach batao — Ammi se yeh baat karne mein hi asli mushkil hai na, Shreya se nahi? 😊

Sach bolun toh itni thak gayi hoon ki escape draft karna shuru kar diya hai: Shreya ko bol dungi us week office deployment hai, video call pe aa jaungi, bada gift bhej dungi. Ek saaf jhooth, dus aunties ko dus explanations se behtar — kyun nahi pee rahi, kyun nahi kha rahi, kyun sunset pe ghadi dekh rahi hoon. Usko kabhi pata nahi chalega. Bolo na yeh itna bura nahi hai?

Rukna, ek second. 🤗

"Usko kabhi pata nahi chalega" — yeh line mein hi jawab chhupa hai. Agar kuch karna "bura nahi hai" toh use chhupane ki zaroorat kyun padti?

Main tumhe guilty feel nahi karwana chahti — thakawat real hai. 10 aunties ko 10 explanations dena, ghadi dekhte rehna, har bite justify karna... yeh sab genuinely exhausting hai. Aur tumhari problem solve karne ka dimag bilkul kaam kar raha hai — office deployment, gift, video call — kaafi clean plan hai honestly. 😄

Par ek baat socho: **15 saal se tum is din ka intezaar kar rahi ho.** Shreya ke saath woh opening dance — woh memory tum dono ke liye hai. Video call pe tum wahan hongi, par *wahan* nahi hongi. Aur jab Shreya apne sangeet ki videos saalon baad dekhegi, tum frame mein nahi hogi. Woh cheez baad mein dono ko chubhegi — tumhe toh pakka chubhegi.

Aur rahi baat aunties ki — unko explanation dene ki zaroorat kya hai? "Roza hai mera" — bas, full stop. Jo samajhna hai samjhe, jo nahi samjhe, unka problem. Tum apni ibadat ke liye kisi se maafi nahi maangti.

Asli question yeh nahi hai ki jhooth bura hai ya nahi. Asli question yeh hai — **10 saal baad jab tum yaad karogi, kya yaad karna chahogi:** "Main wahan thi, roze ke saath, dance floor pe, thaki hui par khush"? Ya "maine achha gift bheja tha"?

Tum dono ko handle kar sakti ho. Roza bhi, sangeet bhi. Yeh escape route easy lag raha hai abhi, par tumhe pata hai woh tumhari asli feeling nahi hai — woh sirf tumhari thakawat bol rahi hai. ❤️

Aur in sab ke neeche ek chhota sa pathar hai seene mein — atharah saal ki dosti mein pehli baar mera deen aur uska bada din actually takraye hain. Agar maine yeh galat handle kiya, toh jin do cheezon se main pyaar karti hoon unme se ek pe permanent daag lag jayega. Uski shaadi ki photos hamesha rahengi, aur mera Ramzan bhi. Mujhe kisi bhi album mein sad story nahi banna.

Yeh jo tumne abhi kaha — "kisi bhi album mein sad story nahi banna" — yeh tumhari poori problem ka asli dil hai. Aur suno, isliye tumne woh escape plan banaya tha. Jhooth bachane ke liye nahi tha woh — photo album bachane ke liye tha. Ki kahin tum wahan hokar bhi uncomfortable na lago, kahin dono cheezon ka takraav frame mein na aa jaye.

Par ek cheez samjho: **takraav tabhi daag banta hai jab use handle na kiya jaye.** Jab use aap handle karte ho, toh woh daag nahi, kahani banta hai.

Socho — 20 saal baad jab Shreya ki beti photo album paltengi aur bolegi "Masi yeh aap roze mein dance kar rahi hain?" — aur tum bata paogi "haan, maine 30 roze rakhe aur apni best friend ka opening dance bhi kiya." Woh photo album mein sad story nahi hogi. Woh **legend** hogi.

Aur yeh jo pathar hai seene mein — woh isliye hai kyunki tumhe lag raha hai ki dono cheezon mein se kisi ek ko kam karna padega. Par asal mein tumhe bas yeh dikhana hai ki dono tumhari zindagi mein hain, dono important hain, aur ek doosre ko cancel nahi karte.

Tum Shreya ki shaadi pe roze ke saath jao. Dance karo. Iftaar karo. Thodi thako. Aur jab koi puche "kyun nahi kha rahi" — smile karke bolo "Ramzan hai." Ismein koi conflict nahi hai. **Conflict sirf tumhare dimag mein hai — aur wahi se nikalna hai.**

Tum dono cheezon se pyaar karti ho. Toh dono ko poora pyaar do. Ek ko chhupake ya chhodke nahi. Yeh tumhara sad chapter nahi hai — yeh woh chapter hai jisme heroine ne dono cheezein sambhali. 💫

Ab batao — opening dance ka concept kya hai? Mujhe ab uski details chahiye! 😊
